# Existing generic credentials can bootstrap a space with no internal IDs.
mkdir local
mkdir remote
mkdir remote/outputs
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote
chmod 0600 rclone.conf
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf setup --remote nas --remote-path outputs --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'success'
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.setup"'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/auto --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf setup --remote-path outputs --local-root $WORK/local --json
stdout 'success'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf space list --json
stdout 'personal'
! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/other --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf setup --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local
stderr 'folder_path_required'
# Config writes are authored by the CLI and preserve unrelated supported keys.
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config init
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config set state $WORK/state
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config set rclone_config $WORK/rclone.conf
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config set local_root $WORK/local
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml setup --remote nas --remote-path outputs --space configured --json
stdout '"space_id":"configured"'
stdout '/local"'
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config show --json
stdout 'rclone.conf'
! exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml config set enabled true
stderr 'unknown_config_key'
# Registration carries the resolved paths, not the invoking shell environment.
exec drivebridge --config $WORK/config.yaml install --client generic --read-only --json
stdout 'rclone-config'
! stdout '"--enabled"'
